name: Wakefield House of Pizza
tagline: Pizza, appetizers, dinners, subs, burgers, salads and party platters on Wakefield Road in Sanbornville, NH.
seo_title: Wakefield House of Pizza | Pizza, Subs & Dinners in Sanbornville, NH
seo_desc: Wakefield House of Pizza, 2076 Wakefield Road, Sanbornville NH. Pizza, appetizers, dinners, subs, burgers, salads, kids menu and party platters. Call (603) 522-3500.
menu_note: The shop's menu covers pizza, appetizers, dinners, subs, burgers, salads, a kids menu and party platters. Call for items and today's prices.
findings: The whole site is one long Squarespace page that is just a text price list (pizza, appetizers, dinners, subs, burgers, salads, kids, party platters).
The only image on the page is the logo; no food or shop photos.
There is no online ordering, only a phone number, so the new site is phone-order only and no ordering link was invented.
Opening hours are not shown on the page (they exist only in hidden page data), so none are shown on the new site.
No About section or story about the shop.
Our fetch of the live page was blocked, so menu items and prices were not copied; the new site lists the menu categories from the lead research and tells customers to call.
questions: Do you have photos of your food and shop we may use? The current site has only the logo.
Can you send your current menu with prices so we can list it on the new site?
What are your opening hours, and are they the same every day?
Do you want online ordering? If you already use an ordering service, please send the link.
Would you like a short About section (your story, how long you have been open)?
Is the Facebook page (facebook.com/whopthereitis) the right social page, and do you have Instagram?
